stem: Represent the relation $2x + y - 3 = 0$ graphically by dragging two points. State the slope and the length of the y-intercept.
solution: The y-intercept is $b = 3$, so the line passes through (0, 3).
Plot (0, 3) and (1, 1), then draw the line through them.
notes: Dropping the minus gives m=2, which fires slope-sign-flipped. Reading b=-3 (the constant as it is written) gives intercept-wrong if the slope is right.
